Dialogs.Dialog: ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... do you actually... not like kissing？
It's just, you seem kind of tense when we kiss...
Yeah... so I thought maybe you actually don't like it.
That's not true！ It's not... it's just, a little...
Like I said... a little... um... just a little embarrassing...
I want to ask you something... how do you feel about kissing？
How do I feel... I like it, you know？
Hehe, really. But more than liking it, it makes me feel at ease, I guess.
I wondered if maybe you didn't like it and were putting up with it.
I see... and if that were true, what would you do？
When you kiss me... it feels so good, and I get so happy, you know？
I see... that's kind of embarrassing.
Hehe, hehehe. You're making such a cute face right now▼
This is sudden, but... how do you feel about kissing me？
How do I feel... are you worried about something？
I wondered if maybe you didn't like it...
What, why？ I don't dislike it, you know？
Just a feeling. Maybe I'm overthinking it.
Yes, you're overthinking. Mood and timing matter, of course, but you can't be so timid.
That's right. Big sis will cheer you on▼
I wondered how ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ feels about it.
Um... well, can I be honest...？
That kind of thing is... I'm not really sure, I guess.
No. I'm sorry I couldn't answer properly.
Um... you know. When we kiss...
Ah, no. I was wondering what you think about when we kiss...
...I can't think about anything, I guess？
You do it without thinking about anything？
It's more like I don't have room to think about anything...
That too... but that I love you, that kind of feeling.
Me!? Ah, um... same, I guess？ Yes. The same feeling... I guess.
This might be hard to answer... but do you like kissing me？
Hmm... if you don't really like it, we don't have to, you know？
Because you always really steel yourself before kissing me, right？ So...
No. I do it because I like it too.
There's no way I don't like it. But I thought if I did it too much, you'd end up not liking it...
Yeah... I'm torn over whether it's okay or not.
I see... hehe. So that's it.
Sorry, for making you worry about something weird.
No, if that's the reason. Just choose your timing, okay？
Hey. Do you like kissing me？
I'm curious. Please, will you tell me？
I can tell you, you know？
Yes. I love kissing you. I love it so much.
Hehe. Once you explain yours well, I'll answer.
Until you find the answer... you can kiss me again. ...But not anytime, anywhere. Think about that properly.
Do you ever think back on when you confessed to me, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
If you ask if I was scared... I was. But I thought it'd be scarier not to say anything.
Because... if, while I stayed quiet, someone else confessed to you...
If that happened, I think I probably wouldn't be able to forgive myself.
So I thought, even if it's a no, I have to at least get my feelings across.
I see... but it wasn't a no, was it？
Yes. I was so happy that you returned my feelings.
When ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ confessed to me... was your heart pounding？
Huh!? Wh-what, all of a sudden!?
Um... well, let's see. My heart wasn't pounding... I think？
It was more like thud, thud, thud.
My heart felt like it would burst. I couldn't breathe, and even when I tried to calm down, I couldn't...
So it wasn't pounding. It was way past that, more intense, you know？
Yeah. You really can't know unless you ask.
Hehe. Then someday I'll ask you a sudden question too, so be ready, okay？
What were you thinking when you confessed to me, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Confessing to someone... I just thought it takes a lot of courage.
Hehe. That's not courage, you know？
Yes. I... actually just wanted to put an end to it. My feelings.
I had studying, and work was fun... I wanted to do lots of things, but I just couldn't get you out of my head... I thought, this is no good.
Right. It was really scary, but I hated standing still doing nothing more...
Even I think I took a bit of a gamble, you know？
And... I'm sure I could go that far because it was you...
Say I were to confess to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
Ah, an example...？ I see... yes, right.
No, never mind. So, if you were to confess？
Yeah. If I were to confess... what would make ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ happy？
Hmm... this is just in my case, right？
For me... I'd be happiest if you said it properly, in plain words.
I see... yeah, things like that need to be said properly.
Huh？ Ah, no. It's nothing. Yes, really nothing.
I wonder what'll happen to us from now on.
I just got curious about the future...
I never thought about it... yeah, you're right. What'll happen？
Mm... but I can't imagine myself dating anyone but you.
Then maybe that's all that matters.
That we don't have to think about it.
Yes. You know, I love you. I'm sure I always will.
Do you regret confessing to me, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Ah... are you worried about me being older？
I don't know... I'm not really sure myself.
I worry about it. Because I wish I were younger too.
But I've never once thought you're unreliable because you're younger.
So... yes, the only thing that bothers me is how others see us, and even that is trivial.
If that's the case, then good...
You can have more confidence in yourself, you know？ After all, you're the person I fell in love with.
...Yeah, you're right. Sorry, for saying something weird.
Hehe. Pull yourself together, Mr. Boyfriend▼
Do you have fun going out with me, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Huh!? What's this all of a sudden？
Mm... I'm younger, so I feel like you might think I'm childish...
...Yes, you are a little childish, maybe？
But, you know, asking that kind of question is what seems childish to me.
I love you, and that's why I confessed. Understand？
I fell for you because you're you, you know？ The childish parts, the not-childish parts, I love all of you.
So don't be weirdly considerate. When you want to be spoiled, you can be. Okay？
Do you think you're the jealous type, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Who knows？ What do you think？
You trust me, right？ Then I won't get jealous.
But that's kind of lonely in its own way？
Then... it's okay if I get jealous？
Then I'll do it so you can't tell. But... don't give me a reason to, okay？
If I got friendly with another girl, would you get jealous after all？
Like... as friendly as ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ and me.
That would mean you're already dating her, right？ So I've been dumped, and there'd be no point getting jealous, don't you think？
No. Sorry for answering weirdly too.
You don't seem like the jealous type, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Because you won't betray me, right？
So even if you get friendly with other girls, it's fine.
Hmm... but I kind of want you to be at least a little jealous...
As my boyfriend？ Hehe. Then from now on, every time I see you talking to a girl, I can get jealous？
Geez. Then I'll get jealous just a little, now and then. Is that okay？
...You're fine as you are. Sorry, for saying something weird.
No. Knowing you care about that kind of thing almost makes me a little happy.
Do you think you're the jealous type, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Sorry, for asking something weird. I was just curious.
Well... I'm intense. When it comes to jealousy.
Intense？ Like, you go on a rampage？
No. The type who goes quiet, broods, and bottles it all up.
If my boyfriend cheated, that'd be it, I think.
Just kidding, I don't actually know. I've never experienced it.
Hehe. But I wonder what it'd really be like？ Part of me wants to know, part of me is scared to...
What happens when ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ gets jealous？
Huh？ What happens... we might have talked about this before... hmm.
Yes. I can't really picture it. But I don't think I'd get jealous...？
Hmm... I'd probably cry first, I think？
Well, it'd mean something happened that made me jealous, right？
Do you want to try making me cry？
Hehe. I'll always believe those words, okay？
Um. Where's the line for things that would make ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ jealous？
We talked about this before... where's the line... I think I'd be fine with most things...
What about me talking with a girl you don't know？
That'd bug me a little... ah, but what matters is whether you're treating her specially.
If you did something with her that you only do with me... I might get jealous.
Things I only do with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
You do lots of them, you know？
Hmm... sorry, I don't really get it.
Hehe. It's fine, as long as I know.
Hypothetically, if I did something that made ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ jealous, what would you do？
What are you going to do, asking me that？
If you ask that, I'll start thinking you're planning to do something like that, you know？
I'm not going to do that.
If it's just a little... I'll let it slide, you know？
You don't have to. I'm never going to do it.
Hehe. Then you didn't need to ask.
Honestly, do you like skinship, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Huh... what, all of a sudden？
Ah, well. I wondered if getting too touchy might not be good.
Could it be I... seemed like I didn't like it？
No, it's not that, just a feeling.
Even now, I get a little nervous... but that's all. It's not that I don't like it.
Besides... if I really didn't like it, I'd say so properly...
So... a little touchiness is okay？
A little, okay？ Ah, but if you really want to, then...
Are you the type who likes skinship, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
You know, they say some people don't like being touchy-feely.
Is... that so？ Aren't people like that rare？
Among people around me, they're a minority, I guess？ What about you？
Me？ I... if it's with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, I like it, I guess.
Then, you'll have to wait. No skinship for a while.
How do you feel about being touched a lot, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Skinship？ I don't dislike it, why？
But not to the point of wanting me to be more forward, huh.
So you'd like to be a little more forward.
Girls need to be treated gently, like something fragile, or you'll ruin it, you know？
Hehe. But you know, if you read the mood, big sis is pretty generous？
Meaning the mood matters. I'm a girl too... okay？
How do you feel about skinship, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Huh？ What, all of a sudden？
Just curious. You know, it's different for everyone...
For me... it depends on the person？
I see. Like, with someone you're dating, it's okay to some extent.
Yes, that's right. The person matters.
How do you feel about my skinship, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
I don't dislike it... yes, I dislike it even less than before, I guess.
I see. It's always me who starts it, so I wondered...
What？ That maybe I actually hate it？
Hehe. You know, when you touch me, sometimes I think, yes！
Yes, I'm happy. Though it's embarrassing too.
They say skinship is important for couples... what do you think, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
I think it's very important... is something wrong？
Well. Like... I wondered what kind you like.
Having your head patted, your ear tickled, your cheek stroked？
You really are fun to tease▼
They say skinship is important for couples... what do you think, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
My... skinship, I guess you'd call it. How do you feel about it？
Being touched, stroked, whispered to, held...
Even just hearing your voice makes me feel so happy.
Even I think it's dangerous, but it must be too late now.
Boyfriend addiction. I get anxious without you, but just having you here makes me happy.
Then I guess I've got girlfriend addiction？
